Edit ONLY the existing 1024×1536 comic page in image 1. BANDIT, adult blue dad: tall broad rounded rectangle, muted blue-gray body, dark navy head mask and outer ears, golden inner ears. Large vertical white eyes and dark pupils; pale gray-white eyebrows. Broad long GOLDEN OCHRE muzzle with PALE surround, GOLDEN OCHRE belly with a broad pale gray-white border. Pale gray-white HANDS and SOCK FEET, clearly distinct from blue forearms/shins; soles are pale gray-white too. Sparse short pale fur dashes only on Dad's dark head/side patches, muzzle, dark tail section. Tail is elongated and thick: DARK navy proximal/root-and-middle section with sparse pale dashes, distal approximately one-third PALE BLUE-GRAY tuft. Dad's tail END must NOT be dark navy.
CHILLI, adult orange mum: slender tall rounded rectangle; orange body and legs, rust-red head side/ear patches with sparse cream fur dashes; cream central forehead stripe, muzzle, eyebrows, belly, hands and sock feet. Sparse CREAM OVAL SPOTS on her torso side and on her ORANGE TAIL. Her tail stays ORANGE through the distal tip, with separate cream spots, NEVER a cream distal cap like Bingo. Golden inner ears.
BINGO, smallest orange child: compact upright rounded rectangle, orange body, red-orange head sides/outer ears, cream central forehead stripe, cream muzzle, belly, eyebrows, HANDS and SOCK FEET. Orange tail base with a small darker red-orange patch, broad CREAM distal tail tip. No adult fur dashes. Exactly two arms/two legs.
BLUEY, blue child: upright rounded rectangle, muted light blue body, dark navy/plum head sides and outer ears, pale blue central forehead wedge, golden inner ears, elongated GOLDEN OCHRE muzzle with thin pale surround, pale gray-white BELLY, eyebrows, HANDS and SOCK FEET/soles (not blue, not dark navy). Dark oval side spots. Tail has LIGHT BLUE root and DARK NAVY distal tip, the opposite color sequence to Dad. No adult fur dashes anywhere. Exactly two arms/two legs, no extra paws.
Preserve occlusion; do not invent a visible tail where it is hidden. Preserve all episode-specific costumes and pen marks if present; these are story props, not inherited fur. Carefully distinguish adult Dad from child Bluey in EVERY panel; preserve Dad's golden belly and larger size. Correct every visible occurrence, including small background figures. Keep speech text and all bubble rectangles unchanged.
